basics.name: Nil Crespo Peiró
basics.label: Senior Computer Vision Engineer | Real-Time Tracking | Sports AI
basics.summary: Senior Computer Vision Engineer at Catapult, leading real-time computer vision for athlete tracking and performance analysis. Academic and production experience spans model development and deployment, tracking evaluation, 3x3 basketball, multi-camera padel tracking, and sports analytics products.

work.name: Catapult / IMPECT
work.summary: Technical leadership and hands-on development of real-time computer-vision and athlete-tracking systems.
highlights: Lead technical direction of computer-vision and tracking systems for movement classification and performance analysis
Manage and mentor a small engineering team while remaining hands-on with system design and development
Train, optimize, and deploy real-time segmentation and classification models in production environments
Extend the tracking pipeline to new movements, metrics, and analysis types
Evaluate tracking accuracy and build quality metrics to improve system reliability

work.name: Deutsche Sporthochschule Köln
work.summary: Automated player tracking and dataset development for 3x3 basketball broadcast video.
highlights: Developed an automated pipeline for a large-scale 3x3 basketball player-tracking dataset from single-camera broadcast footage
Designed game-segment detection, court registration, player detection and tracking, 3D ball localization, and court-coordinate projection methods
Addressed identity fragmentation across cuts and occlusions using re-identification, jersey-number recognition, appearance features, and spatiotemporal constraints
Produced a tracking dataset forming part of an upcoming publication

work.name: AiBall

Designed backend data models and APIs for clubs, courts, cameras, reservations, players, and matches
Integrated club-management and reservation platforms and automated match creation, recording, and processing
Built operational dashboards and monitoring for data quality, processing pipelines, camera/NVR health, and club performance
Contributed to distributed video processing using cloud storage, background workers, and automated alerts
